mainImage.alt: Satellite image shows fires and smoke near El Fasher airport as RSF forces captured the city in October 2025
mainImage.caption: Satellite image shows fires and smoke near El Fasher airport, Sudan, in October 2025 as RSF forces captured the city after a 500-day siege. Credit: Getty Images via TIME

body.alt: Satellite evidence from Yale Humanitarian Research Lab shows mass killing sites in El-Fasher October 27 2025
body.caption: Satellite imagery published by the Yale Humanitarian Research Lab shows evidence of mass killings in El-Fasher on October 27, 2025, including white objects consistent with human remains. Credit: Yale Humanitarian Research Lab via France 24

body.alt: Satellite image of Saudi hospital in El-Fasher showing damage after RSF attack October 2025
body.caption: Satellite image shows the Saudi hospital in El-Fasher after RSF takeover on October 30, 2025, with visible damage from the paramilitary assault. Credit: Planet Labs PBC via NPR
